description: Tauri 2.5 signs a text resource during MSI bundling and SignTool rejects it, based on https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/13341.
prompt:
After bumping the Tauri CLI to 2.5.0 our signed Windows MSI build started failing. The only unusual resource is a bundled README file.

SignTool Error: This file format cannot be signed because it is not recognized.
